reuse.why: Extracts downloadSingleAccountTransactions and shares it with Akahu, reuses the link.ts helpers and the akahu startingBalance branch, but the link handler and the extra status/accounts handlers are copied rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies linkAkahuAccount almost line for line, and fintegraStatus/fintegraAccounts copy akahuStatus/akahuAccounts, adding three provider-agnostic copies.

placement.why: Link and status handlers in accounts/app.ts, download and balance handling in accounts/sync.ts, endpoint in server-config.ts, type in types/models, as the tree organises providers.

scope.why: Adds fintegra-status and fintegra-accounts requests that the server-side request did not ask for, plus refactors the Akahu download path.

maintainability.why: The shared download helper is a real improvement, but more copies of the link and status flows enlarge the surface a future fix must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses link.assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, syncAccount dispatch and processBankSyncDownload; no existing shared link function to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount, fintegraStatus and fintegraAccounts in accounts/app.ts are open copies of their Akahu siblings.
